wwo.name: Beijing
wwo.method: Partial 1900 plan. Historic centerline and land-use boundaries reconstructed in a jointly registered local frame. Building massing is inferred at mapped residential and commercial edges. Street-side massing is inferred along readable routes in the Outer City. The separate original Forbidden City landmark remains the palace model; plan geometry supplies its surroundings.

sources.licence: Public domain, French Dépôt de la Guerre map. Traces use the Harvard facsimile linked from Commons.
sources.precision: 1:15,000 historical plate. Street and water tracings are approximate; several map labels obscure minor passages.
Historical ceremonial use and monument continuity. Modern coordinates are control references.
Palace boundaries, court distinctions and Ming/Qing usage.

sources.date: Ming/Qing site; coordinates on UNESCO listing and Commons
sources.precision: Site history and Hall of Prayer control; grove extent interpreted from period tree markings.
CRS84 control from the modern object location.
Approximate modern White Dagoba control on Jade Island.
CRS84 modern tower centroid; 1900 wall corner trace.
Modern former-gate approximate coordinates, with reference links in registration.

registration.method: Regularized thin-plate spline fitted to nine modern location references in metres.
registration.limits: Schematic position within the control envelope. No inference of urban extent outdoors or outside the traced features. Eastern older gate references are approximate.
